item.title: Clawdbot/Moltbot/OpenClaw is cool, but it gets pricey fast
item.description: Rarely have I more appreciated the chasm between me and Silicon Valley than I have while using OpenClaw. item.title: How to design a sabbatical that actually changes you
item.description: For many people, the word sabbatical conjures a very specific image: a long break from work, perhaps time spent on a beautiful beach, maybe a few weeks of rest before returning “recharged.” It’s often perceived as indulgent, impractical, or reserved for academics and executives with generous benefits.
